The '''Lounger 432GLM''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] lounge floater produced by [[Gafladen]]. It included adjustable [[Repulsor field/Legends|repulsor fields]] for comfort and [[micro-inducer]]s to generate a relaxing massage.
